en.headline: September inflation rises to 1.9 percent, underlying rate at 2.1 percent
en.dek: The Composite CPI increased more than in August, driven mainly by faster rises in transport fares and package tour charges, the Census and Statistics Department said.
body: Hong Kong’s Composite Consumer Price Index rose 1.9 percent year on year in September 2026, up from 1.7 percent in August, the Census and Statistics Department announced on Thursday.

After netting out the effects of all one-off government relief measures, the underlying inflation rate stood at 2.1 percent, compared with 1.9 percent the previous month. The department said the larger year-on-year increase was mainly due to faster rises in inbound and outbound transport fares and charges for package holidays.

Among the major components, electricity, gas and water rose 12.9 percent, miscellaneous services 5.3 percent, and transport 5.2 percent. Basic food fell 0.2 percent and alcoholic drinks and tobacco fell 0.4 percent.

A government spokesman said the underlying rate was higher than in August, largely driven by faster price increases in fuel-related items, while price increases in other major components remained generally mild. Looking ahead, the spokesman said inflation would continue to face upward pressure from elevated international oil prices linked to geopolitical tension in the Middle East, but other price pressures were expected to remain largely contained, so overall inflation should stay moderate.

zh.headline: 9月綜合消費物價指數按年升1.9% 基本通脹率2.1%
zh.dek: 升幅較8月擴大，主要因進出香港交通費及套裝旅遊費用升幅加快，統計處公布。
body: 政府統計處周四公布，9月綜合消費物價指數按年上升1.9%，較8月的1.7%為高。剔除所有政府一次性紓困措施的影響後，基本通脹率為2.1%，亦高於8月的1.9%。
統計處指，按年升幅擴大主要是由於進出香港交通費和套裝旅遊費用的升幅加快所致。
各類組成項目中，電力、燃氣及水上升12.9%，雜項服務上升5.3%，交通上升5.2%。基本食品下跌0.2%，煙酒下跌0.4%。
政府發言人表示，基本通脹高於上月，主要由燃料相關項目價格升幅擴大帶動，其他主要組成項目價格升幅大致輕微，整體通脹保持溫和。展望將來，中東地緣政治局勢持續緊張令國際油價高企，影響將繼續傳導至燃料相關項目，但其他方面價格壓力料仍大致受控，整體通脹應保持溫和。
